gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai builds words like solid blocks, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. Noto Sans Vai lets paragraphs settle into a dense, steady texture, while Tektur brings diagonals as heavy as its verticals.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Tektur draws every diagonal as stout as every upright, with generous openings on each curve. Noto Sans Wancho then carries the reading in hulking, chalky lowercase, so paragraphs feel pressed in with weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Tektur holds its line at zero modulation, every curve finishing with a generous opening. Noto Traditional Nushu meets it with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, so bowls fill the line beside it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-numans: Pipe-cleaner strokes up top, swollen rope-like lowercase below. Tektur has no stroke contrast whatsoever, while Numans pushes its tracking well past normal and lets each s hang its ends far from the spine.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-pathway-extreme: Hairlines nowhere, swells nowhere: Tektur keeps every stroke uniform and every curve open. And Pathway Extreme brings stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, with rounded letters that stay clearly open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-pt-sans-caption: Expressive from the first stroke, Tektur keeps one unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions. PT Sans Caption settles beside it with big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed and inviting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-questrial: Tektur is all personality, pipe-cleaner strokes with generous openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. Questrial is the plain sans doing the quiet work, with flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-radio-canada: Tall, full c, s and z give this sans-serif text a steady line with a clear opening on each curve. Radio Canada does the quiet reading work, whereas Tektur is the one built to be noticed.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-ruda: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes leave generous openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. Ruda, a sans-serif, meets those strokes with its own wire-like monoline skeleton and wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption sets big-bodied lowercase around bowls that feel unclosed and inviting, so the text reads generously. Funnel Display adds strokes like cut lengths of cord, rounded and uniform.
